subject: Startups
title: Non-Competes and Non-Solicits
description: A 60-second lesson on Non-Competes and Non-Solicits.

hook.text: California bans non-compete agreements entirely. That's one reason Silicon Valley innovates faster than anywhere else.

buildup.text: Non-competes prevent employees from joining competitors. Non-solicits prevent them from poaching clients or coworkers.

discovery.text: In 2024, the FTC proposed banning non-competes nationwide, calling them harmful to workers and innovation.

twist.text: Even where enforceable, broad non-competes scare away top talent.

climax.text: Narrow non-solicits are reasonable. Broad non-competes are increasingly seen as anti-competitive relics.

punchline.text: Talent flows where freedom flows. Don't build a prison.

quiz.question: Why does California ban non-compete agreements?
options: To promote employee mobility and innovation
